documentation: TTL-first key/value cache backed by Redis. Values are JSON-encoded strings; a declaration-level `ttl` is the default expiry for set() calls that do not name their own. Dependency-free RESP2 client. Not the `store` KV backend — this is a plain capability, not wired into `mhl serve`.

properties.name: url
properties.documentation: redis://[user:pass@]host:port/db (rediss:// for TLS). Use env("REDIS_URL"). Fills addr/username/password/db/tls; wins over the discrete fields.

properties.name: addr
properties.documentation: host:port (used when `url` is unset). Default localhost:6379.

properties.name: password
properties.documentation: AUTH password. Use env("REDIS_PASSWORD"); the host resolves and redacts it.

properties.name: tls
properties.documentation: Connect over TLS (managed Redis: ElastiCache in-transit, Upstash, …). Implied by a rediss:// url.

properties.name: ttl
properties.documentation: Default expiry for every set() without its own ttl: "30s" / "5m" / "1h" or a number of seconds. Unset = keys never expire.

properties.name: key_prefix
properties.documentation: Namespace prepended to every key (stored, not stripped).

properties.name: dial_timeout
properties.documentation: Connect timeout as a Go duration. Default 5s.

properties.name: read_timeout
properties.documentation: Per-command read/write timeout as a Go duration. Default 3s.

properties.name: log
properties.documentation: Optional path to append a JSON-lines wire trace (op + key, never values).

methods.name: get
methods.documentation: The JSON-decoded value, or null when the key is absent.

methods.name: set
methods.documentation: Store value (JSON). ttl overrides the declaration default: "30s"/"5m" or seconds.

methods.name: delete
methods.documentation: Remove the key. Absent key is not an error.

methods.name: incr
methods.documentation: Atomically increment the integer at key by 1 and return it (INCR).

methods.name: incrBy
methods.documentation: Atomically add n and return the new value (INCRBY).

methods.name: expire
methods.documentation: Set/refresh the key's expiry; false when the key does not exist.

methods.name: ttl
methods.documentation: Remaining seconds: -1 = no expiry, -2 = missing key.
